party_hints.election_day: Party registration of voters who cast a ballot on Election Day. Polls are open 7 am to 7 pm local time (the Panhandle's Central-time counties close at 8 pm Eastern); counties post check-ins to their turnout feeds through the day, most about hourly, and this updates about every 10 minutes. Lake County's Election Day figures are copied by hand from the Lake County Supervisor of Elections' Current Elections page (6 pm), not its TQV feed.
party_hints.not_voted: Registered voters who haven't cast a ballot yet, by party: each county's registration by party (Florida Division of Elections, as of September 30, 2026) minus its ballots cast so far, updated as ballots come in. Registration is a monthly snapshot, so people who registered between then and the Oct. 5 deadline aren't in it. This is the pool left, not a forecast: many of them won't vote.
